scope_boundary: Audit Ekonerg's QA system. Other companies are not audit targets; supplier controls are checked only where supplier work can affect Ekonerg quality.
source_basis: DOC-0017: activity levels include study, design, consulting, engineering, testing, and other services.
DOC-0012/DOC-0013: controlled and work procedures govern Ekonerg activities.
DOC-0024/DOC-0025: purchasing and supplier evaluation controls.
DOC-0027/DOC-0028: verification, audits, and management review.
DOC-0029/DOC-0030: nonconformance, Part 21, and corrective action controls.

rulings.basis: Ekonerg procedures assign QA, management, team, and verification roles across its organization and supplier oversight.
The QMS document-control and quality-plan procedures cover Ekonerg activities and contracts.
Ekonerg documents identify study, design, engineering, and project-control activities, including review and verification stages.
Procurement and supplier-evaluation procedures control purchased services and requirements.
Ekonerg uses controlled procedures and work procedures for quality-affecting activities.
Issued and received documents, revisions, distribution, and retention are controlled.
Ekonerg controls purchasing, supplier evaluation, and supplier design-work verification.
The evidence shows services and project work, but does not yet prove that Ekonerg fabricates or installs traceable physical items. Confirm per contract or project.
The evidence describes engineering and testing services, not welding, heat treating, or nondestructive examination performed by Ekonerg. Confirm whether any project invokes a special process.
Control procedures, internal checks, supplier checks, and design-work verification require inspection or review activities.
Testing is listed among Ekonerg activity types, but the applicable test program and acceptance limits must be confirmed for each project.
Ekonerg controls measuring equipment, but its use in a particular safety-related activity must be confirmed from project evidence.
Document and record storage is evidenced; handling, storage, and shipping of nuclear items is not yet evidenced for Ekonerg's service scope.
Inspection and testing controls exist, but item or system operating-status marking is not shown. Confirm if a contract requires it.
Ekonerg has a procedure for deviations and nonconformances in Ekonerg and supplier activities.
Corrective-action, nonconformance, and Part 21 reporting controls are explicitly documented.
Quality records, project records, and corrective-action records have defined control or retention evidence.
Ekonerg documents internal checks, management review, reporting, and follow-up activities.

decision_note: No criterion is marked NOT_APPLICABLE yet. Conditional criteria need contract or project evidence before a final N/A decision. Owner G2 approval is required before writing rulings to the audit database.
